canonical_project: Central Bank of Montenegro disaster-recovery micro data center, Zabljak
notes: Montenegrin press profile of Cikom states that, for the Central Bank of Montenegro, Cikom built a disaster-recovery site in Zabljak as a micro data center including HP/VMware backup equipment, DCIM, access control, temperature monitoring, fire detection and suppression, and video surveillance. No MW capacity disclosed; treated as an enterprise DR micro data center rather than hyperscale/colocation.
